response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise and proven ability to work with distributed systems at scale, but faces a critical gap: his C++ experience is ~10 years outdated (last work in 2014-2015), with no Rust experience despite these being the primary required technologies. Recent career trajectory over the past 5 years has shifted toward TypeScript/Node.js and AI infrastructure, moving away from systems programming. While he demonstrates strong learning ability, senior-level thinking, and the role explicitly seeks candidates comfortable expanding expertise, significant technical ramp-up time would be required on the core technology stack.
strengths: Founded and maintains GISCollective (geo-data platform); developed web GIS applications for Green Map; direct domain expertise in geospatial systems and mapping infrastructure.
Designed and operated systems handling millions of HTTP requests per second with focus on low-latency performance, caching, async I/O, and high-performance databases.

15+ years senior-level experience across diverse complex systems; demonstrates architectural thinking, strong learning ability across tech stacks, and mentorship (organized refactoring dojos and testing workshops).
concerns: C++ expertise is ~10 years outdated (last significant work 2014-2015 at National Instruments); no Rust experience despite both being primary and acceptable alternative requirements.

Career trajectory over past 5 years diverging from systems programming: current role (2025-present) and recent work focused on TypeScript/Node.js and AI infrastructure rather than low-level systems work.
Geospatial domain knowledge is present, but no demonstrated experience with routing optimization, navigation algorithms, tile-based systems, or traffic data integration specific to routing pipelines.
